sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(AVG(yt/(anglers+1)), 2) as avg_yt_per_angler, MAX(yt) as max_yt FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 175 AND fish_date_doy <= 182 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC
SELECT fish_date_doy, ROUND(AVG(yt/(anglers+1)), 2) as avg_yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 160 AND fish_date_doy <= 182 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT ts_doy, ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 1) as avg_water_c, ROUND(MIN(wtmp_c), 1) as min_water_c, ROUND(MAX(wtmp_c), 1) as max_water_c FROM pier WHERE ts_doy >= 175 AND ts_doy <= 182 GROUP BY ts_doy ORDER BY ts_doy DESC

SELECT target_date_doy, ROUND(AVG(mf_seas), 1) as seas_ft, ROUND(AVG(mf_wind_max), 1) as wind_kt FROM marine_forecasts WHERE target_date_doy >= 182 AND target_date_doy <= 190 GROUP BY target_date_doy ORDER BY target_date_doy

import pandas as pd

# Analyze the early peak window d175-d182
trips = tables['trips']

# Filter to d175-d182
peak_window = trips[(trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 175) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 182)]

# Group by doy and class to see what's happening
by_day_class = peak_window.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
by_day_class['yt_per_angler'] = (by_day_class['yt'] / (by_day_class['anglers'] + 1)).round(2)

# Multi-day trips performance
multi_day = peak_window[peak_window['cls'].isin(['day_1_5', 'multi_day'])]
multi_day_stats = multi_day.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count', 'mean'],
    'anglers': 'mean'
}).round(2)

print("Multi-day trips (DAY_1_5 + multi_day) performance d175-d182:")
print(multi_day_stats)
print()

# Check THREE_QUARTER performance 
three_q = peak_window[peak_window['cls'] == 'three_quarter']
three_q_stats = three_q.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count', 'mean'],
    'anglers': 'mean'
}).round(2)
print("THREE_QUARTER trips d175-d182:")
print(three_q_stats)
print()

# Overall summary by day
daily_summary = peak_window.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
daily_summary['total_yt_per_angler'] = (daily_summary['yt'] / (daily_summary['anglers'] + 1)).round(2)
print("Daily average (all classes) d175-d182:")
print(daily_summary[['fish_date_doy', 'total_yt_per_angler']].sort_values('fish_date_doy', ascending=False))
